title: Singam II
desc: Durai Singam, a policeman working an undercover operation, attempts to eliminate a drug trafficking ring in the coastal town of Thoothukudi.

title: Samar
desc: After receiving an invitation from his former girlfriend in Bangkok, a forest guide visits her in the hope of reconciliation, but becomes embroiled in a series of bizarre events.

title: Dada
desc: Manikandan, a young boy, endures many hardships and faces the challenges of raising a son as a single parent after accidentally impregnating his lover.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Kaavalan
desc: Bhoomi highly respects Muthuramalingam and his daughter Meera. While appointed as Meera's bodyguard, he falls in love with a girl he has never met, unaware that she is none other than Meera.
